# PREFACE Pin Studio

> PREFACE Pin Studio is an internal Pinterest content planning, owner-approved publishing and analytics tool operated solely for the PREFACE Jewelry Pinterest business account.

## Key facts

- Operator: PREFACE Jewelry.
- Purpose: prepare Pinterest content from PREFACE Jewelry product information and brand-owned images; publish owner-approved Pins; record publishing status; retrieve Pin and account analytics.
- Human oversight: every Pin is reviewed and approved by the Pinterest account owner before publication.
- Authorized data: account identifiers, boards, Pins, publishing status and Pinterest-provided analytics for the authorized PREFACE Jewelry account.
- Third-party access: the application does not provide Pinterest account access or Pinterest data to third parties.
- Data sale: Pinterest data is not sold or rented.
- Public policy: https://momoerica106453-netizen.github.io/preface_jewelry/
- Contact: https://www.instagram.com/preface_jewelry/
